name: Neo4j
description: Developer/data platform: graph database with the Aura cloud service, an Aura management REST API and Cypher query interfaces.
access_notes: AuraDB has a free tier and the docs state 'All tiers can create Aura API credentials' - client ID/secret are self-generated from the Aura Console account settings.
mcp_notes: Official Neo4j MCP server (github.com/neo4j/mcp, docs at neo4j.com/docs/mcp) - a local binary/PyPI server that connects to any Neo4j deployment; additional Labs MCP servers under neo4j-contrib. Composio NEO4J toolkit exists (21 tools, mostly Aura management; no Composio managed auth).
uncertainty_notes: Aura API is management-focused (instances, snapshots, projects); data-plane access is via Bolt drivers or the Query API (HTTP, basic auth) rather than a single broad REST surface. No outbound webhooks found in Aura API docs; not conclusively determined. Official MCP is local (stdio/http self-run), not a hosted remote endpoint.

evidence.note: 'The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0' with client_credentials grant at https://api.neo4j.io/oauth/token (HTTP Basic with client ID/secret); 'All tiers can create Aura API credentials' from the console.
Aura API lets you 'programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances'; REST base URL https://api.neo4j.io.
Official Neo4j MCP documentation; vendor-owned repo github.com/neo4j/mcp described as 'Neo4j official MCP Server'.
Composio NEO4J toolkit: 21 tools (Aura instance/snapshot/project management), auth OAUTH2/BASIC/API_KEY, no Composio managed app.
